[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 4>. Inside the royal bedroom (<Subject 1>), defined by its marble walls, fluted columns, and a dark green bed frame featuring gold eagle motifs, Philomela (<Subject 2>) sits comfortably on the bed's pink and brown bedding. She is a young woman with long wavy blonde hair and a golden laurel wreath crown, wearing a pale pink silk nightgown with cold-shoulder lace sleeves. Standing to the left is her maid (<Subject 3>), who has a brown crown braid and wears a simple short-sleeved beige linen tunic tied at the waist. The room is softly accented with subtle lily of the valley and olive branch decorations in the background. Looking up at the maid with a bright, joyful expression, Philomela (S1) smiles and speaks, <d>[English] Today is my eighteenth birthday. I've finally come of age.</d> She raises a delicate hand to her chest, her eyes shimmering with anticipation as she continues, <d>[English] Perhaps I can break free from my father's constraints, see the world beyond the temple, <scenetrans></d>

[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of the maid (<Subject 3>). She looks warmly toward the right side of the frame, her brown crown braid and the coarse texture of her beige linen tunic clearly visible in the soft lighting. The off-screen Philomela (S1) continues her vocal line from the previous shot, <d>[English] <scenetrans>and maybe meet someone who shares my heart, and have a love of my own.</d> As the off-screen voice expresses these heartfelt wishes, the maid smiles gently and nods in understanding. After the utterance, Philomela's voice stops, leaving only the faint, peaceful daytime room ambience audible. The maid slowly lowers her chin, completing her affirmative nod, and maintains her supportive, smiling gaze through the shot's ending.
